rules.description: Block reading, copying, sending or planting credentials, however the command is spelled — the one line nobody should relax
Even relaxed, the agent may not quietly switch actiongate off: changes to the hook settings, ag-hook or gateway state wait for a human
Only destructive actions wait for a human: bulk deletes, force pushes, dropped tables, wiped disks, destroyed cloud resources. Code the analyzer cannot inspect runs (that is the relaxed trade-off)
